name: signoff
description: A local decision page for coding agents: the agent lists its open decisions with mockups, highlight boxes, costs and a preselected recommendation; you answer in the browser and press Done. Local only: it listens on 127.0.0.1 and sends nothing out.

folder.title: Decisions folder
folder.description: Where the agent keeps a topic folder per decision, relative to the project root or absolute. The past-decisions page reads the same folder.

hint.title: Waiting hint
hint.description: While the Signoff inbox runs, how a session shows what waits on you in its project: band (a line above the prompt), status (a status line entry) or off (nothing shown; messages you send from the inbox still reach the session). Any other value is band.

plan.title: Plan review
plan.description: While the Signoff inbox runs, where you review a plan when Claude leaves plan mode: inbox (the plan waits on a Plan review round in the Signoff inbox, and your answer goes back to the session) or off (Claude Code's own dialog). Any other value is inbox.
